task.ques: Compare the maximum number of private repositories allowed in the Free and Pro plans in GitHub Pricing.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: GitHub Free and GitHub Pro both allow unlimited private repositories; neither has a fixed maximum number. GitHub Pricing lists “Unlimited public/private repositories” for Free, and GitHub’s plan documentation confirms Pro includes Free’s features. Sources: https://github.com/pricing and https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/learning-about-github/githubs-plans (accessed October 28, 2026). Evidence: final.png.
